sections.title: Camera, movement and interpolation
items: Keep the words on a stable composition plane during their readable state. Reveal each word with its own schedule and spatial envelope. A whole-line opacity fade loses the distinct formation observed in the source.

Use separate curves for position, orientation and scale. An intermediate pose should not force a full stop unless the reference visibly pauses. Judge the projected silhouette and screen velocity, not just whether handles are Bézier.

sections.title: Lighting, materials and focus
items: Warm abstract studio field: a defocused copper/orange environment with broad soft reflections on dark objects. Proposed rig: large rectangular key, warm rim and low fill, with a separate background gradient so copy contrast can be controlled without changing the phone material. This is a descriptive treatment, not an identified HDRI.

Previous material becomes soft while new words become clear. Control each text group’s blur independently from position/opacity; stop blur before the reading interval. The incoming coin must occlude text rather than be a transparent crossfade.
Lighting descriptions name the visible treatment and an inferred reconstruction. Original light powers, lens, aperture, shutter and compositing settings are unknown unless explicitly recorded below.

sections.title: Construction controls and implementation order
items: Block the incoming and outgoing states first. Establish the main object trajectory, then schedule child actions and reading intervals. Add focus and exposure blur after the trajectory is intelligible. The following controls are a build plan, not measured source settings.

tables.caption: Native construction controls
rows: Endless begins around 6.9 s; Confirmation develops separately and both resolve by roughly 7.3 s.
Separate word objects or AE text groups; animate glyph offsets/reveal without reflowing the completed line.
Keep about 7.35–8.0 s comparatively calm; do not introduce continuing wobble to fill the duration.
Render in front of copy with solid center/edge alpha and separate exposure blur.
